Thinking mode, from source (read, not run): in mlx_lm 0.31.3, TokenizerWrapper.apply_chat_template sets enable_thinking to has_thinking when the caller does not pass it (tokenizer_utils.py:336-337), and has_thinking (391-392) is true because Gemma 4's vocab has <|channel> and <channel|> (274-282). With enable_thinking true, the model's chat_template.jinja adds <|think|> (lines 182-183). With it false or unset, the template prefills an empty, closed '<|channel>thought\n<channel|>' (lines 359-360). mlx_lm.generate accepts --chat-template-config to pass template arguments.
